Name: Multiply
Description: Multiplies each value by a specified factor.

Name: Shaper
Description: Applies a shaping function to modify the curve of values.

Name: Clamp
Description: Restricts values to a specified minimum and maximum range.

Name: Clip
Description: Limits values by cutting off those outside a given range.

Name: Drop
Description: Removes values below or above a certain threshold.

Name: Autolevel
Description: Automatically adjusts values to span the full output range.

Name: Equalize
Description: Redistributes values to achieve a more uniform distribution.

Name: Strong
Description: Enhances the contrast or intensity of values.

Name: Invert
Description: Flips values to their opposite within the range.
